scope: Global Route-1 closer for the fixed-seed beta denominator squarefull/excess-valuation capacity after two-copy clearing-reservoir normalization

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For sqfull(n)=product over v_p(n)>=2 of p^v_p(n) and E(n)=n/rad(n), one has E(n)|sqfull(n)|E(n)^2; hence their logarithms are little-oh equivalent.
claims.evidence: report Section 1; primewise exponent proof; certificate bounded exponent replay
claims.scope_limit: definition distinguishes the full powerful-supported part from the squarefull radical

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: After removing two copies of the clearing divisor D_m, J=(Delta g)/gcd(Delta g,D_m^2) divides (q_N/gcd(q_N,D_m))^2.
claims.evidence: report Section 2; exact primewise inequality (2.10); certificate sequential exponent box
claims.scope_limit: this is an upper-capacity normalization, not a positive matching theorem

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The fixed-seed denominator satisfies log q_N=N log N+(log 4-1)N+O(log N), and therefore only the tautological main-scale uniform bound log sqfull(q_N)<=log q_N is currently available.
claims.evidence: report Section 3; exact lower and upper products plus Stirling
claims.scope_limit: does not assert that the ceiling is attained by actual q_N

claims.label: PROVED_DEPENDENCY_SYNTHESIS
claims.claim: On a dyadic block and cutoff X=C N log N, the squarefree smooth support and all excess levels p^a<=N have average o(N log N) per term.
claims.evidence: report Section 4; sealed zero-gap and prime-square branching theorems
claims.scope_limit: the complementary levels p^a>N remain uncontrolled

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The high-level block mass splits into a singleton maximum plus pairwise overlap; transfer/gcd estimates control only overlap and are exactly blind to prime powers supported at one index.
claims.evidence: report Section 5; inequality (5.4) and gcd identity (5.6)
claims.scope_limit: does not prove the singleton maximum is large or small

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_BARRIER
claims.claim: Reverse-Bessel discriminants determine simple roots but not the divided Hensel value q_N/p mod p; standard singleton-sensitive block resultants are already main-scale and their first nonzero subresultants erase singleton depth.
claims.evidence: report Section 6; sealed Item 204 and block-resultant dichotomy
claims.scope_limit: rules out the stated standard shortcuts, not every possible arithmetic method

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_LOGICAL_NO_GO
claims.claim: Primitive-divisor and largest-prime-factor statements alone cannot upper-bound the total powerful-supported cofactor, so they do not imply the desired squarefull little-oh theorem.
claims.scope_limit: does not deny or weaken any primitive-divisor theorem

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY
claims.claim: The independent standard-library checker verifies the fixed-seed, reverse-Bessel, transfer/gcd, reservoir, sequential, and squarefull exponent identities on explicit bounded ranges without searching for exceptional primes.

claims.label: PROVED_BOOKING_DECISION
claims.claim: The positive-linear-capacity admission test fails: Item 265 books zero new Route-1 rate and zero new capacity reduction.
claims.scope_limit: Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi remain open
